_comment: Sound-effect manifest for JustaLittleFun Racing (non-voice). Mirrors vo-manifest.json. Each entry under 'sounds' is keyed by the name the game calls it by (e.g. playSound('gates')). 'url' is either a single file or an array of interchangeable takes: one-shots pick a random take per play; loops pick one take when they start. 'bus' routes it through the mixer (music / crowd / weather / sfx / voice); defaults to 'sfx' if omitted. 'loop': true marks a continuous bed (crowd, rain, hooves, gate rattle, menu music). All paths are relative to basePath. This file is overlaid on the inline fallback table in the page by key: entries here override or add to it, anything omitted keeps its built-in definition. Missing files stay silent and never block the game. _comment keys are ignored by the loader.

postTrumpet._comment: 'Call to the Post' bugle at the race-view transition

gates._comment: gates clang/spring as they fly open

stumble._comment: impact as a runner goes down; random take per fall

whinny._comment: horse cry on a fall; random take

thunder._comment: thunderclap on storm lightning; random take

gateRattle._comment: horses shuffling in the stalls: race-view transition until gates open

breeze._comment: soft wind bed for petals / autumn leaves / light snow
